description: Schema definition for Vendor entity that stores comprehensive vendor information and their relationships

id.desc: Unique identifier for the vendor record

company.desc: Name of the company associated with the vendor; references the Companies schema's name field

addressLine1.desc: Primary address line for the vendor's address

addressLine2.desc: Secondary address line for the vendor's address (optional)

city.desc: City where the vendor is located

state.desc: State or region of the vendor's address

country.desc: Country where the vendor operates or is based

postalCode.desc: Postal or ZIP code of the vendor's address

phoneNumber.desc: Contact phone number for the vendor

email.desc: Contact email address for the vendor

taxRegistrationNumber.desc: Tax registration number associated with the vendor

currencyId.desc: Identifier for the currency associated with the vendor

currencyCode.desc: Currency code (e.g., USD, EUR) for the vendor

irs1099Code.desc: IRS 1099 code for the vendor (if applicable)

paymentTermsId.desc: Identifier for the payment terms agreed upon by the vendor

paymentMethodId.desc: Identifier for the default payment method for the vendor

taxLiable.desc: Indicates if the vendor is subject to tax

blocked.desc: Status flag indicating if the vendor is blocked or inactive

balance.desc: Current balance associated with the vendor's account

lastModifiedDateTime.desc: Timestamp when the vendor record was last modified
